defective_pattern: Failing to establish RTL directionality across all 4 OpenXML layers: 1) Injecting <w:bidiVisual w:val='1'/> instead of <w:bidiVisual/>. 2) Omitting <w:bidi/> or appending it after <w:docGrid/> in w:sectPr. 3) Missing <w:themeFontLang w:bidi='fa-IR'/> in word/settings.xml. 4) Omitting <w:bidi w:val='1'/> in table cell paragraphs.
why_defective: MS Word requires exact RTL declarations across the document settings, section properties, table properties, and paragraph properties. Incorrect attribute injection (w:val='1' on bidiVisual) or misordered elements (bidi after docGrid) silently corrupts RTL rendering.
observed_symptoms: RTL tables rendered LTR in MS Word
Validation blindspots permitting w:val='1' on bidiVisual
corrective_remedy: 1) Inject <w:bidiVisual/> as empty without w:val. 2) Ensure <w:bidi/> precedes <w:docGrid/> in w:sectPr. 3) Update word/settings.xml with <w:themeFontLang w:bidi='fa-IR'/>. 4) Enforce <w:bidi w:val='1'/> in <w:pPr> of all table cell paragraphs.

detection_heuristic.trigger_rule: Detects presence of w:val='1' on bidiVisual
